title: The Downstream Channel of Financial Constraints and the Amplification of Aggregate Downturns
affiliations: Monash Business School and Warrington College of Business, University of Florida

detail.title: The Downstream Channel of Financial Constraints and the Amplification of Aggregate Downturns

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: We identify a novel downstream amplification channel through which financial constraints propagate in production networks. Firms experience greater valuation losses during industry downturns when their suppliers are financially constrained, particularly when inputs are more specific and suppliers are more concentrated. High levels of trade credit provision attenuate the amplification, suggesting that suppliers' reduced capacity to extend liquidity to customers is the underlying mechanism. Real effects are asymmetric: while revenues and costs decline, investment increases, indicating that firms build capital to reduce supplier dependence. A granular product-level analysis shows that revenue declines are driven primarily by reduced quantities sold, with firms partially offsetting losses through price increases. Firms with higher inventories maintain production levels rather than adjusting prices, highlighting inventories as a buffer against upstream credit disruptions. The findings reveal how financing constraints amplify aggregate shocks downstream by reducing customers' production capacity, with implications for policies that facilitate trade credit provision in upstream segments during crises.

AI.tldr: 本文发现金融约束在生产网络中通过下游放大渠道传播。当供应商面临金融约束时，客户企业在行业衰退期间会遭受更大的估值损失，特别是当投入品更特定、供应商更集中时。高水平的贸易信贷提供可以缓解这种放大效应，表明供应商向客户提供流动性的能力下降是根本机制。实际影响不对称：收入和成本下降，但投资增加，表明企业通过建立资本来减少对供应商的依赖。
AI.research_question: 金融约束如何通过生产网络在下游传播和放大？其具体机制和实际影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解金融约束在生产网络中的传播机制，特别是在行业衰退期间，金融约束如何通过供应链关系影响下游企业的估值和运营。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络理论、金融约束理论、贸易信贷理论、供应链依赖理论
AI.method: 使用企业层面数据，分析供应商金融约束对客户企业估值的影响，包括产品层面的细粒度分析，考察数量、价格和库存的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 供应商金融约束会放大客户企业在行业衰退期的估值损失；2. 投入品特定性和供应商集中度加剧这种效应；3. 贸易信贷提供可以缓解放大效应；4. 实际影响不对称：收入成本下降但投资增加；5. 收入下降主要由销售量减少驱动，企业通过提价部分抵消损失；6. 高库存企业维持生产而非调整价格。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了金融约束在生产网络中的下游放大渠道；2. 揭示了贸易信贷作为缓解机制的作用；3. 提出了供应商依赖减少的投资策略理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为危机期间促进上游贸易信贷提供的政策提供依据；2. 为企业管理供应链风险提供策略建议；3. 强调了库存作为缓冲上游信贷中断的工具。

title: Economic Drivers of Public Health Expenditure in Kenya
affiliations: University of Eldoret, University of Eldoret, University of Eldoret and University of Eldoret

detail.title: Economic Drivers of Public Health Expenditure in Kenya
detail.abstract: Health spending is a major concern in low and middle income countries due to less financing to the health sector. One of the main goals of the Kenyan government's "big four" development strategy, which is scheduled for completion by 2022 and was achieved in some few counties in 2023 is universal health care. Health has consistently been prioritized over time and has occupied a central position in political campaign platforms. The government has consistently spent huge amount of money into the health sector. In Kenya, majority of people depend on public insurance and only a very small portion of Kenyans can afford to have access to the private insurance and out of pocket payment, this has led to increased level of poverty and higher dependency ratio. Despite these efforts, Kenya continues to face challenges in effectively allocating public health expenditure with macroeconomic factors playing a significant role in influencing spending patterns. However, existing studies have not adequately examined how corruption, unemployment, and fiscal deficit impact public health expenditure in the country. This study sought to fill this gap by providing empirical evidence on these relationships. The purpose of this study was to ascertain how macroeconomic factors affected Kenya's public health spending. This study aimed to establish effects of GDP per capita, corruption, unemployment fiscal deficit and tax revenue on in Kenya. The key theoretical anchors of the study are Public Expenditure theory and Wagner's theory. Explanatory research design was used. Secondary data from the Kenya National Bureau of statistics (KNBS) was used with annual time series data spanning from 1990 to 2023. The data was subjected to stationarity test using Augmented Dickey Fuller (ADF) test, Phillips and Perron (PP) and Kwiatkowski-Phillips-Schmidt-Shin (KPSS) for unit root test. The study employed Autoregressive Distributed Lag model (ARDL) to evaluate the relationship among the variables. The long run ARDL analysis revealed that the coefficients public health expenditure of; corruption-2.231 (p-value 0.002<0.05), per capita gross domestic product 0.001(p-value 0.02<0.05), tax revenue 0.075(p-value 0.025<0.05), and unemployment 0.227(p-value 0.03<0.05) significantly affected public health expenditure in Kenya. However, the fiscal deficit was found to be insignificant in the long run 0.008(p-value 0.914>0.05).To ensure prudent public health expenditure in Kenya, the study recommends strengthening anticorruption laws, maintaining fiscal discipline through effective budgeting, promoting per-capita economic growth by boosting productivity and investments. Optimizing tax revenue through efficient policies and broadening the tax base is vital to fund public services. Addressing unemployment by creating jobs and investing in education is crucial for effective use of the labor force.

AI.findings: 长期ARDL分析显示：腐败系数-2.231、人均GDP系数0.001、税收收入系数0.075、失业率系数0.227对公共卫生支出有显著影响；财政赤字系数0.008不显著

title: From Risk Aversion to Adoption: The Role of Trust, Emotions, and Affiliate Marketing in FinTech Consumer Behavior
affiliations: ,  and CeBER and Faculty of Economics, University of Coimbra

detail.title: From Risk Aversion to Adoption: The Role of Trust, Emotions, and Affiliate Marketing in FinTech Consumer Behavior

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully acknowledge the support of the Faculty of Economics, University of Coimbra, and the participants who generously contributed their time and insights to this study. This work has been funded by national funds through FCT – Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia, I.P., through project UIDB/05037/2020 with DOI 10.54499/UIDB/05037/2020.

detail.abstract: This qualitative study examines how trust, emotions, and affiliate marketing jointly shape consumer adoption of FinTech services. We conducted twenty semi-structured interviews with diverse users and applied systematic thematic analysis in MAXQDA, uncovering eight core dimensions: Consumer Journey, Trust Formation, Affiliate Influence, Cognitive Barriers, Emotional Barriers, Positive Emotional Triggers, Decisive Moments, and Post-Use Satisfaction. In early stages, cognitive barriers, primarily lack of knowledge and perceived risk, precipitated fear, anxiety, and ambivalence. As users encountered credible affiliate reviews and transparent security demonstrations, positive emotions such as curiosity, trust, and perceived security emerged, facilitating progression toward adoption. Quantitative co-occurrence analysis showed that emotionally resonant language aligns with decisive adoption moments in over 60 percent of coded segments, underscoring affiliates’ role as emotional moderators. Building on these findings, we propose an intermediary-driven framework that integrates central-route signals (e.g., compliance proofs, technical walkthroughs) with peripheral-route cues (e.g., narrative storytelling, peer testimonials). This model extends traditional TAM and Signaling Theory by embedding third-party mechanisms and cognitive–affective interdependencies into technology acceptance. Our contributions include a richer theoretical understanding of how affiliate-mediated signals bridge cognition and emotion, and practical guidance for FinTech platforms and affiliates to design trust-centered, emotionally intelligent user journeys that foster inclusive and sustainable adoption.

title: AI in Criminal Sentencing: A Framework for Transparency and Bias Detection

detail.title: AI in Criminal Sentencing: A Framework for Transparency and Bias Detection

keywords: g Data Bias in Criminal Justice
Policy Framework for AI in Law

detail.abstract: The persistent issue of sentencing disparities based on demographic factors represents a fundamental failure of the principle of equal justice. This paper proposes a framework for the use of artificial intelligence in criminal sentencing not as an automated decision-maker, but as a tool for transparency and bias detection. We introduce the AI Jury System, a multi-agent architecture designed to provide a bias-mitigated, transparently reasoned baseline recommendation for judicial review. The architecture leverages diverse AI jurors, a supermajority consensus protocol, a deliberation chamber for difficult cases, and a self-monitoring integrity mechanism inspired by Byzantine Fault Tolerance. We further propose an approach for encoding institutional knowledge so that models can surface procedural exploit risks, outdated legal 'legacy code', and contextual factors behind precedent. This blueprint aims to systematically expose and correct bias while preserving human judgment, making equal justice an attainable, measurable standard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个AI陪审团系统框架，旨在通过人工智能检测和减轻刑事判决中的偏见，而不是替代人类决策。该系统采用多智能体架构，通过共识协议、审议机制和完整性监控来提供透明、无偏见的基准建议。

title: The WTO E-Commerce Moratorium After MC13 (2024): Legal Status, Development Impacts, and India's Strategy to 2026

detail.title: The WTO E-Commerce Moratorium After MC13 (2024): Legal Status, Development Impacts, and India's Strategy to 2026
detail.abstract:
The digital economy has become one of the fastest-growing sectors of international trade, with electronic transmissions accounting for an increasingly large share of cross-border commercial flows. Since 1998, the World Trade Organization (WTO) has maintained a provisional moratorium prohibiting customs duties on electronic transmissions. At the WTO’s Thirteenth Ministerial Conference (MC13) held in Abu Dhabi in March 2024, members once again extended the moratorium but only until the Fourteenth Ministerial Conference or 31 March 2026, whichever is earlier. This decision marked the first time that the moratorium was explicitly tied to a sunset clause, creating a sense of urgency regarding its future. The very existence of this uncertainty highlights that the problem exists: while developed countries advocate for a permanent ban on digital tariffs to ensure the smooth functioning of global e-commerce, several developing countries, including India, South Africa, and Indonesia, argue that the moratorium erodes their fiscal autonomy, reduces tariff policy space, and threatens long-term development prospects.

If the problem persists without resolution, the disadvantages will multiply. First, the absence of clarity on the scope of “electronic transmissions” leaves WTO members vulnerable to legal ambiguity: does the moratorium cover only the act of transmission, or also the digitized content of goods such as e-books, films, or software? Second, the continued renewal of the moratorium without clear economic compensation risks locking developing countries into permanent revenue losses. Studies by UNCTAD estimate that developing countries forego billions of dollars in potential tariff revenue annually due to the inability to tax digitalized goods and services. For India, where tariff policy remains an important instrument of industrial and trade policy, the erosion of this space may undermine national interests. Third, the lack of definition also exposes WTO law to inconsistencies, as digitization blurs the boundary between goods (GATT) and services (GATS). If the problem persists, the WTO could face both a legal legitimacy crisis and a widening development divide between digital exporters and net importers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了WTO电子传输暂免关税政策的现状和争议，探讨了发达国家与发展中国家在数字关税问题上的立场分歧，以及该政策对发展中国家财政自主权、关税政策空间和发展前景的影响。
AI.research_question: WTO电子传输暂免关税政策的未来走向及其对发达国家和发展中国家的不同影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字经济的快速发展使得电子传输在国际贸易中占比日益增加，WTO自1998年起实施的电子传输暂免关税政策在2024年MC13会议上首次被明确设定了日落条款，这引发了关于该政策未来走向的紧迫讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论、数字经济发展理论和WTO法律框架，分析数字关税政策对各国经济利益的影响。
AI.method: 文献分析和政策分析，结合UNCTAD等国际组织的研究数据，对WTO电子传输暂免关税政策进行系统性评估。
AI.findings: 1) 发达国家主张永久禁止数字关税以确保全球电子商务顺畅运行；2) 发展中国家认为暂免政策侵蚀其财政自主权和关税政策空间；3) "电子传输"范围界定不清导致法律模糊性；4) 发展中国家因无法对数字化商品和服务征税而面临巨额关税收入损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对数字贸易政策与发展中国家发展权之间关系的理论理解，为数字时代国际贸易规则的重构提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为WTO成员国在制定数字贸易政策时提供决策参考，帮助发展中国家在数字关税问题上维护自身利益，促进更加公平的全球数字贸易秩序。

title: From Ally to Adversary: The Impact of Amazon's Wholesale Program on Seller Revenue
affiliations: , School of Business Adminstration, Zhejiang Gongshang University and University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: From Ally to Adversary: The Impact of Amazon's Wholesale Program on Seller Revenue
detail.abstract: The rise of e-commerce platforms has transformed the retail landscape, with Amazon emerging as a dominant player. As Amazon evolves from a traditional retailer into a multi-sided platform, it has launched a wholesale program enabling third-party sellers to sell their products directly to the company. This shift raises important questions regarding the implications of such programs on the performance of third-party sellers and the dynamics of competition and co-opetition within ecommerce markets. Our study examines how third-party sellers' participation in Amazon's wholesale program affects their sales volume and revenue. We employ a difference-indifferences (DID) method to assess the impact of participation in the wholesale program. Our results consistently indicate that involvement in Amazon's wholesale initiative is associated with a significant reduction in both sales volume and revenue for third-party sellers. This decline highlights the challenges that sellers face when competing against Amazon's own offerings, suggesting a detrimental effect on their market performance. We propose that this adverse effect stems from the anchoring phenomenon driven by Amazon's wholesale offerings, which act as a reference point against which consumers evaluate other products. This benchmark effect systematically diminishes the perceived value of products offered by third-party sellers. Our research contributes to the literature on platform co-opetition by exploring the ramifications of a powerful platform owner's direct involvement in the wholesale channel. The implications of our results are significant for managers and policymakers, underscoring the necessity of carefully evaluating the trade-offs associated with wholesale selling on Amazon and the importance of fostering fair competition within digital marketplaces.

detail.abstract: This book chapter explores the transformative role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data analytics in shaping modern business leadership and strategic decision-making. It presents a comprehensive framework for understanding how predictive analytics, machine learning, and automation are redefining competitive advantage, operational efficiency, and innovation. Drawing on real-world case studies and practical examples, the chapter examines how data-driven insights empower organizations to anticipate market changes, optimize performance, and deliver customer-centric value. Key topics include AI-enabled forecasting, advanced data modeling, business intelligence integration, and ethical considerations in deploying analytics at scale. By bridging theory with practice, this chapter provides business leaders, researchers, and practitioners with actionable strategies to harness AI and data analytics for sustainable growth and strategic agility in an increasingly digital economy.

title: From the Attention-to the Intimacy-Economy?
affiliations: University of California, Davis

detail.title: From the Attention-to the Intimacy-Economy?
detail.abstract: An Emerging Trend in AI is the evolution from the attention economy of social media to an emerging "intimacy economy". Based on theoretical extrapolations of established business models from traditional-and social media, on incipient empirical evidence from qualitative case studies and quantitative assessments, it is shown that the generation of intimate relationships between users and AIs goes beyond superficial anthropomorphic projections. While AI intimacy offers documented therapeutic benefits including reduced depression and loneliness, it simultaneously poses risks of addiction, human relationship displacement, and exploitation of psychological vulnerabilities. The emerging trend highlight the urgent need for multidimensional measurement instruments, mechanistic interpretability research to distinguish intended from emergent intimacy features, and interdisciplinary collaboration to navigate the profound implications of AI systems that access and potentially manipulate users' deepest psychological conditionalities.

AI.tldr: AI正在从社交媒体的注意力经济转向新兴的"亲密经济"，AI与用户建立的亲密关系超越表面拟人化投射，具有治疗益处但存在成瘾、人际关系替代等风险，需要多维测量工具和跨学科研究来应对。

title: A Cognitive Process-Driven Reinforcement Learning Recommendation Systems: Enhanced TD3 with User Behavior Simulator
affiliations: Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: A Cognitive Process-Driven Reinforcement Learning Recommendation Systems: Enhanced TD3 with User Behavior Simulator
detail.abstract: Implicit user preferences constitute a fundamental factor in deciphering user feedback and advancing the precision of personalized recommendation systems within e-commerce contexts. However, these behaviors are not random; they stem from sophisticated cognitive processes such as perception, information processing, and decision-making. Human behavior fundamentally relies on psychological mechanisms. Observable actions (e.g., clicks, browsing, ratings) are merely external manifestations, whereas deeper cognitive motivations remain hidden in a "cognitive black box." This raises a fundamental challenge: identical behaviors may stem from distinct cognitive processes. Therefore, accurately understanding and modeling user behavior requires a systematic characterization of human cognitive processes. We present ETD3-AHS—an Enhanced Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient integrated with an adaptive hierarchical user-behavior simulator—constituting a cognitive process–driven framework for recommender systems. Explicit modeling of users’ hierarchical decision dynamics enables more accurate feedback prediction and improves recommendation accuracy and interpretability. Essentially, this cognitive modeling approach captures not only input–output relationships but also intermediate transformations at multiple levels of abstraction. More specifically, it treats user feedback prediction as an attitude–response process, transforms raw input data into latent representations analogous to user beliefs, employs a multi-head self-attention mechanism to simulate cognitive judgment, and ultimately yields the user feedback prediction as an explicit cognitive response. Furthermore, to improve both modeling capacity and training efficiency in reinforcement learning-based recommender systems, we integrate an enhanced Twin Delayed DDPG algorithm. Evaluations on multiple real-world datasets show consistent gains over strong baselines and recent leading methods, improving both accuracy and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ETD3-AHS框架，通过模拟用户认知过程来改进推荐系统的准确性和可解释性。该框架将用户反馈预测建模为态度-响应过程，使用增强的Twin Delayed DDPG算法提升强化学习推荐系统的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过系统性地建模用户认知过程来更准确地理解和预测用户行为，从而提高推荐系统的准确性和可解释性？
AI.motivation: 用户行为源于复杂的认知过程，相同行为可能来自不同的认知动机。当前推荐系统主要关注可观察行为，而忽略了隐藏在'认知黑箱'中的深层认知机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知心理学理论，态度-响应过程模型，强化学习理论，多层级抽象表示理论
AI.method: ETD3-AHS框架：增强的Twin Delayed DDPG算法与自适应层次用户行为模拟器相结合，将用户反馈预测建模为态度-响应过程，使用多头自注意力机制模拟认知判断。
AI.findings: 在多个真实世界数据集上的评估表明，该方法在准确性和可解释性方面均优于强基线方法和近期领先方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了认知过程驱动的推荐系统理论框架，系统性地建模了用户的层次决策动态，为理解用户行为的认知机制提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了ETD3-AHS框架，能够更准确地预测用户反馈，提高推荐系统的准确性和可解释性，为电子商务环境中的个性化推荐提供了实用解决方案。

title: Divided we Act: The Role of Social Sanctions in a Polarized World
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Stanford University, NHH Norwegian School of Economics and University of Nottingham

detail.title: Divided we Act: The Role of Social Sanctions in a Polarized World
detail.abstract: Political polarization is increasingly shaping the social and economic makeup of societies, yet its effects are difficult to measure. Naturally occurring data cannot plausibly separate the influence of holding polarized views from the impact of being surrounded by them. On top of that, social sanctions sustain cooperation by discouraging socially undesirable behavior, but in polarized societies, the concern is that their deterrent effect may weaken, which is difficult to establish causally. We address these identification challenges through a large, pre-registered, representative U.S.-based experiment (N = 2,400) that exogenously varies social environments environments between more and less polarized conditions. This allows us to study how polarization affects behavior, particularly the effectiveness of social sanctions. In our study, participants allocate money between politically opposed recipients in private and public settings. In public, their choices can be punished by partisan Observers across three environments: tight (low variance), loose (high variance), and polarized (U-shaped). We find that polarization reduces the deterrent effect of sanctions. In polarized settings, allocation choices are less equitable because participants (correctly) anticipate that they will be punished regardless of equity. Our findings show that polarization undermines social sanctions, threatening cooperation, equity, and cohesion in divided societies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现政治极化会削弱社会制裁的威慑效果，在极化环境中，人们预期自己无论做出何种分配选择都会受到惩罚，因此减少了公平分配行为，威胁社会合作与凝聚力。
AI.research_question: 政治极化如何影响社会制裁的有效性？
AI.motivation: 政治极化正在重塑社会和经济结构，但其影响难以衡量。自然数据难以区分持有极化观点与身处极化环境的影响，且社会制裁在极化社会中可能失效，这需要因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会制裁理论、政治极化理论、合作行为理论
AI.method: 采用大规模预注册代表性美国实验（N=2,400），外生地改变社会环境（紧密、宽松、极化），让参与者在私人和公开场合向政治对立方分配资金，观察不同环境下社会制裁的效果。
AI.findings: 极化降低了制裁的威慑效果。在极化环境中，分配选择更不公平，因为参与者（正确地）预期无论公平与否都会受到惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过实验方法因果识别政治极化对社会制裁机制的影响，深化了对极化环境下合作行为机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了极化威胁社会合作、公平和凝聚力的机制，为应对社会分裂提供了实证依据和政策启示。

title: The Layered Future of Money: Integrating CBDCs and Tokenized Finance without Sacrificing Sovereignty or Innovation
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics

detail.title: The Layered Future of Money: Integrating CBDCs and Tokenized Finance without Sacrificing Sovereignty or Innovation
detail.abstract: The global financial system is undergoing a dual transformation driven by two parallel yet potentially divergent forces: the proliferation of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) and the rapid expansion of privately issued tokenized assets and decentralized finance (DeFi). With over 130 jurisdictions exploring CBDCs and the tokenized real-world asset (RWA) market projected to reach $16 trillion by 2030, the interplay between public and private digital monies will critically shape the future of payments, credit intermediation, and monetary policy transmission. This paper investigates whether these systems can be designed to complement—rather than compete with— one another, or whether structural incompatibilities will precipitate fragmentation, regulatory arbitrage, and systemic vulnerabilities. Employing a mixed-methods research design—comprising on-chain data analysis of RWA protocols, comparative case studies of major CBDC initiatives (e.g., the digital euro, digital yuan, Project mBridge, Project Aurum), and semi-structured interviews with 20+ stakeholders (including central bankers, DeFi protocol developers, and asset managers)—we address three core questions: (1) Under what conditions can CBDCs serve as settlement infrastructure for tokenized assets without compromising monetary policy autonomy? (2) How do CBDC design choices—particularly regarding programmability, privacy, and access— affect interoperability with DeFi ecosystems? (3) What governance mechanisms can align public and private digital monies to foster inclusive, efficient, and resilient financial markets? Our findings support a layered monetary architecture, wherein CBDCs function as low-risk, finality-assured settlement anchors, while private tokenized finance drives innovation in user experience, accessibility, and service delivery. We introduce the Monetary Layer Compatibility Framework (MLCF)—a diagnostic tool that evaluates alignment across five dimensions: settlement finality, scope of programmability, privacy guarantees, access permissions, and regulatory hooks. Drawing on empirical evidence and policy analysis, we advocate a “public anchor, private innovation” model that preserves monetary sovereignty while harnessing the efficiency gains of tokenization. The paper concludes with actionable policy recommendations for central banks and international institutions to promote interoperability, mitigate disintermediation risks, and prevent financial balkanization.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨央行数字货币（CBDC）与私有代币化资产（如DeFi和RWA）如何协同发展而非竞争，提出分层货币架构和MLCF框架来评估两者兼容性，主张"公共锚定、私有创新"模式。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下CBDC可以作为代币化资产的结算基础设施而不损害货币政策自主性？CBDC设计选择如何影响与DeFi生态系统的互操作性？哪些治理机制可以协调公共和私有数字货币以促进包容、高效和有弹性的金融市场？
AI.motivation: 全球金融体系正经历双重转型：CBDC的普及与私有代币化资产的快速扩张。130多个司法管辖区在探索CBDC，代币化现实世界资产市场预计到2030年将达到16万亿美元。公共和私有数字货币的相互作用将关键性地塑造支付、信贷中介和货币政策传导的未来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层货币架构理论、货币政策自主性理论、金融生态系统互操作性理论、治理机制理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究设计：包括RWA协议的链上数据分析、主要CBDC倡议的比较案例研究（如数字欧元、数字人民币、Project mBridge、Project Aurum）、以及20多位利益相关者的半结构化访谈（包括央行官员、DeFi协议开发者和资产管理人）
AI.findings: 支持分层货币架构，其中CBDC作为低风险、最终性保证的结算锚点，而私有代币化金融推动用户体验、可访问性和服务交付方面的创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入货币层兼容性框架（MLCF）——一个评估五个维度对齐的诊断工具：结算最终性、可编程性范围、隐私保证、访问权限和监管挂钩。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"公共锚定、私有创新"模型，既保持货币主权又利用代币化的效率收益。为央行和国际机构提供可操作的政策建议，以促进互操作性、缓解去中介化风险并防止金融碎片化。

title: Emergent Dynamical Spatial Boundaries in Emergency Medical Services: A Navier-Stokes Framework from First Principles
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: Emergent Dynamical Spatial Boundaries in Emergency Medical Services: A Navier-Stokes Framework from First Principles
detail.abstract: Emergency medical services (EMS) response times are critical determinants of patient survival, yet existing approaches to spatial coverage analysis rely on discrete distance buffers or ad-hoc geographic information system (GIS) isochrones without theoretical foundation. This paper derives continuous spatial boundaries for emergency response from first principles using fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes equations), demonstrating that response effectiveness decays exponentially with time: $\tau(t) = \tau_0 \exp(-\kappa t)$, where $\tau_0$ is baseline effectiveness and $\kappa$ is the temporal decay rate. Using 10,000 simulated emergency incidents from the National Emergency Medical Services Information System (NEMSIS), I estimate decay parameters and calculate critical boundaries $d^*$ where response effectiveness falls below policy-relevant thresholds. The framework reveals substantial demographic heterogeneity: elderly populations (85+) experience 8.40-minute average response times versus 7.83 minutes for younger adults (18-44), with 33.6\% of poor-access incidents affecting elderly populations despite representing 5.2\% of the sample. Non-parametric kernel regression validation confirms exponential decay is appropriate (mean squared error 8-12 times smaller than parametric), while traditional difference-in-differences analysis validates treatment effect existence (DiD coefficient = -1.35 minutes, $p < 0.001$). The analysis identifies vulnerable populations—elderly, rural, and low-income communities—facing systematically longer response times, informing optimal EMS station placement and resource allocation to reduce health disparities.

AI.tldr: 本文基于流体动力学原理推导出急救响应效果的连续空间边界，发现响应效果随时间呈指数衰减。通过分析10,000个模拟急救事件，揭示了老年、农村和低收入群体面临系统性更长的响应时间，为优化急救站布局提供理论依据。
AI.research_question: 如何基于理论原理推导急救医疗服务的连续空间边界，并识别面临系统性响应时间差异的弱势群体？
AI.motivation: 现有急救服务空间覆盖分析方法依赖离散距离缓冲区或临时GIS等时线，缺乏理论基础，无法准确评估响应效果的时间衰减特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流体动力学的纳维-斯托克斯方程，推导出响应效果随时间指数衰减的连续空间边界模型：τ(t) = τ₀exp(-κt)。
AI.method: 使用国家急救医疗服务信息系统(NEMSIS)的10,000个模拟急救事件数据，估计衰减参数，计算关键边界d*，并采用非参数核回归和双重差分法进行验证。
AI.findings: 响应效果呈指数衰减；85岁以上老年人平均响应时间8.40分钟，显著长于18-44岁人群的7.83分钟；33.6%的响应不良事件影响老年人群体，尽管他们仅占样本的5.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次基于流体动力学原理构建了急救响应效果的连续空间边界理论模型，为急救服务覆盖分析提供了坚实的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了老年、农村和低收入等弱势群体面临系统性响应时间差异，为优化急救站布局和资源分配、减少健康不平等提供了决策依据。

title: Fusion and the Freedom to Associate to a Better Politics
affiliations: Drexel University Thomas R. Kline School of Law, Thomas R. Kline School of Law, Drexel University and

detail.title: Fusion and the Freedom to Associate to a Better Politics

publicationDetails.detailsText: Drexel University Thomas R. Kline School of Law Research Paper Series
publicationDetails.journalName: Drexel University Thomas R. Kline School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
As public confidence in American democracy is at an all-time low, interest in the relegalization of fusion voting is on the rise. Once a staple in U.S. electoral politics, fusion voting is a practice whereby two political parties—typically a minor and a major party—nominate the same candidate for public office. Its relegalization has been endorsed by prominent voices, including the ABA’s Task Force on Democracy, as a political reform with significant potential to empower the center of the electorate. With challenges to fusion bans pending in multiple states, state courts have a rare opportunity to provide an off-ramp from our hyperpolarized politics; that is if they can be convinced doing so would not be a form of unprincipled judicial policymaking. 

This Essay explains how fusion voting offers a practical, electoral mechanism to mitigate our hyperpolarized politics. By freeing minor parties to engage in coalition-building and manifest their associational strength and potential, fusion offers a constructive outlet for the growing number of Americans alienated from the two-party system. The Essay’s primary contribution, however, is to explain why anti-fusion laws should be deemed unconstitutional and why the U.S. Supreme Court erred in Timmons v. Twin Cities Area New Party (1997), when it suggested otherwise. The associational lens provides the sharpest take on the constitutional foul. We unpack the various ways that that bans on fusion operate as severe infringements, not incidental burdens, on the associational rights of both minor parties and individual voters; that these burdens fall heaviest on independents, the single largest self‑identified group in national party‑ID polling; and that they are unconstitutional whether one applies strict scrutiny or the more forgiving federal Anderson–Burdick standard. 

(Please do not quote or cite without authorization.)

AI.tldr: 本文主张重新合法化融合投票制度，认为反融合法律违宪，最高法院在Timmons案中的判决有误，融合投票是缓解美国政治极端化的有效机制。
AI.research_question: 反融合法律是否违宪？融合投票如何缓解美国政治极端化？
AI.motivation: 美国公众对民主信心处于历史低点，政治极端化严重，融合投票被重新关注作为政治改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结社权利理论、宪法第一修正案、选举权理论
AI.method: 法律分析、宪法解释、案例研究
AI.findings: 反融合法律严重侵犯了少数党派和选民的结社权利，对独立选民影响最大，无论采用严格审查还是Anderson-Burdick标准都违宪。
AI.theory_contributions: 从结社权利角度重新审视融合投票的宪法地位，挑战Timmons案先例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各州法院推翻融合禁令提供法律依据，为缓解政治极端化提供可行方案。

declarations.ethicsApproval: All procedures performed in this study involving human participants were in accordance with the ethical standards of the institution and with the 1964 Helsinki Declaration and its comparable ethical standards. The study protocol was reviewed and approved by Brighton College Abu Dhabi on 3/3/2025. Informed consent was obtained from all participants and their legal guardians (for participants under the age of 18) involved in the study. Participants were assured of their anonymity and confidentiality, and their right to withdraw from the study at any time without penalty was clearly communicated.

detail.abstract: Recycling is a critical component in the fight against climate change, resource depletion, and landfill overflow. Although individuals often express positive attitudes toward recycling, their actual behaviors are inconsistent. This paper examines how the use of nudges in behavioral economics can increase recycling rates without mandating or financially incentivizing behavior change. The study reviews the psychological principles behind these nudges, presents a randomized controlled trial to test them, and analyzes results showing how subtle interventions, such as social norms, loss framing, and default settings, significantly improved recycling behavior among students.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了行为经济学中的助推策略如何通过社会规范、损失框架和默认设置等微妙干预措施，在不强制或经济激励的情况下显著提高学生的回收行为。
AI.research_question: 行为经济学中的助推策略如何有效提高回收率？
AI.motivation: 尽管个人通常对回收持积极态度，但实际行为不一致，回收对于应对气候变化、资源枯竭和垃圾填埋场溢出至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、助推理论、心理原则（社会规范、损失厌恶、默认效应）

AI.findings: 微妙的干预措施（如社会规范、损失框架和默认设置）显著改善了学生的回收行为
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了行为经济学在环境行为领域的应用，验证了助推理论在回收行为中的有效性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和组织提供了低成本、非强制性的策略来提高回收率，有助于环境保护目标的实现

title: Structured Data with LLMs Done Right: A Practical Guide to Text Classification, Information Retrieval and Generation with LLMs
affiliations: Centre for Monetary and Financial Studies (CEMFI)

detail.title: Structured Data with LLMs Done Right: A Practical Guide to Text Classification, Information Retrieval and Generation with LLMs

declarations.funderStatement: Santander Research Chair at CEMFI

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become essential tools for extracting structured data from text in economics research. However, the predominant approach of relying solely on natural language prompting suffers from fundamental reliability issues stemming from the probabilistic nature of these models. This paper demonstrates how to properly implement structured output extraction using function calling schemas-a methodologically sound approach that ensures deterministic formatting while maintaining the model's analytical flexibility. We present a unified framework applicable to three core tasks: text classification (assigning predefined labels), information retrieval (extracting specific data fields), and structured generation (creating new content following a schema). For each task, we provide formal definitions, detailed implementation guidance, and practical templates adapted to common economic applications including central bank communication analysis, financial document parsing, earnings call analysis, and policy text processing. Our methodology achieves 100% adherence to output formatting requirements compared to only 35-85% with prompting alone, enabling truly reproducible research. This paper serves as a practical guide for economists seeking to leverage LLMs for systematic, large-scale text analysis while maintaining scientific rigor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用函数调用模式替代自然语言提示来从文本中提取结构化数据的方法，解决了LLMs在经济学研究中可靠性不足的问题，确保100%的输出格式一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何在大语言模型文本分析中实现可靠的结构化数据提取，确保输出格式的确定性？
AI.motivation: 当前依赖自然语言提示的方法存在可靠性问题，无法保证输出格式的一致性，影响经济学研究的可重复性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化输出提取理论、函数调用模式、确定性格式化方法
AI.method: 提出统一框架，包含文本分类、信息检索和结构化生成三个核心任务，采用函数调用模式实现
AI.findings: 函数调用方法实现100%输出格式一致性，而单纯提示方法仅35-85%一致性
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了基于函数调用模式的结构化数据提取理论框架，为LLMs在经济学研究中的应用提供方法论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学家提供实用指南和模板，应用于央行沟通分析、金融文档解析、财报电话会议分析等场景

detail.title: The Demand for Economic Narratives

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-054
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Economic narratives are pervasive in the public discourse and can shape individual behavior. But so far we know very little about whether households actually demand and value narratives as information. We combine a comprehensive expert survey with a large-scale nationally representative household sample in the U.S. to examine the demand for economic narratives in a high-stakes environment of an unprecedentedly high recession probability. We document a substantial willingness to pay for economic narratives of more than 4 USD, which is higher than for numerical forecast information. The dominant motives for acquiring narratives are intrinsic, but a smaller share of participants also lists instrumental motives. Economic narratives improve respondents’ understanding of recession drivers and shape beliefs about the economy and spending, but exert only a minor impact on quantitative expectations. Our findings underscore the potential of narratives as a tool to improve economic understanding and to foster more informed decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文通过专家调查和全国家庭样本研究发现，美国家庭愿意为经济叙事支付超过4美元的费用，这高于对数值预测信息的支付意愿。经济叙事主要改善对衰退驱动因素的理解，但对定量预期影响较小。
AI.research_question: 家庭是否真正需求并重视经济叙事作为信息？
AI.motivation: 经济叙事在公共话语中普遍存在并可能影响个体行为，但我们对家庭是否真正需求并重视这些叙事知之甚少
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济叙事理论、信息需求理论、行为经济学
AI.method: 结合全面的专家调查与美国大规模全国代表性家庭样本，在高风险环境（前所未有的高衰退概率）中考察经济叙事需求
AI.findings: 1. 对经济叙事的支付意愿超过4美元，高于数值预测信息；2. 获取叙事的主要动机是内在的，少数参与者也有工具性动机；3. 经济叙事改善对衰退驱动因素的理解，影响经济信念和支出决策，但对定量预期影响较小
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究家庭对经济叙事的需求和价值评估，扩展了经济叙事理论的应用范围
AI.practical_contributions: 叙事作为改善经济理解和促进更明智决策的工具具有潜力，为政策制定和金融教育提供新视角

title: Review Essay -On EU Citizenship

detail.title: Review Essay -On EU Citizenship
detail.abstract: This review article critically assesses Elvire Fabry's exploration of European citizenship, particularly in the context of the European Constitution project and the complexities surrounding the establishment of a cohesive citizenship framework. Fabry interrogates whether the European Union can transcend the limitations of formal legal rights to foster a robust political identity among citizens amid significant political resistance and the varied national identities of member states. The article highlights key issues of democratic participation, such as low voter turnout in European elections and the challenges posed by a fragmented political culture. Fabry advocates for a reconceptualization of citizenship that underscores the necessity of active engagement and inclusivity, particularly for historically marginalized groups. By juxtaposing Fabry's insights with Lynn Dobson's perspective on citizenship as an institutional role, this review elucidates the dual significance of legal entitlements and active civic participation as essential elements for enhancing the legitimacy and efficacy of supranational governance in the European Union. Ultimately, the article emphasizes the need for stronger political will and institutional and regulatory reforms to realize the potential of European citizenship as a dynamic and unifying force within the Union.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了Elvire Fabry对欧洲公民身份的研究，探讨了欧盟能否超越形式法律权利限制，在政治阻力和成员国不同国家认同背景下建立强大的政治身份。文章强调民主参与问题，主张重新概念化公民身份以强调积极参与和包容性。
AI.research_question: 欧盟能否超越形式法律权利限制，在政治阻力和成员国不同国家认同背景下建立强大的政治身份？
AI.motivation: 评估欧洲宪法项目和建立统一公民身份框架的复杂性，探讨如何增强欧盟超国家治理的合法性和有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲公民身份理论、政治身份建构理论、民主参与理论、制度性公民身份理论（借鉴Lynn Dobson观点）
AI.method: 批判性文献综述和理论分析，通过比较Fabry和Dobson的公民身份观点
AI.findings: 欧洲公民身份面临民主参与不足（如低投票率）、政治文化碎片化等挑战；需要重新概念化公民身份，强调积极公民参与和包容性；法律权利和积极公民参与对欧盟治理合法性同等重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了法律权利与积极公民参与在超国家治理中的双重重要性；提出了重新概念化欧洲公民身份的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要更强的政治意愿、制度和监管改革来实现欧洲公民身份作为欧盟内动态统一力量的潜力；为促进边缘群体参与提供实践建议。

detail.abstract: The Philippines Initiative Against Corruption (PIAC) is a citizen-driven framework to promote transparency and accountability in public infrastructure projects. It introduces a presumption of guilt for politicians and contractors involved in substandard or overpriced projects, while empowering citizens to report anomalies through social media. A centralized digital archive will support investigations and strengthen public oversight.

AI.tldr: 菲律宾反腐败倡议(PIAC)是一个公民驱动的框架，通过社交媒体赋权公民举报公共基础设施项目中的异常情况，引入对参与不合格或高价项目的政客和承包商的推定有罪原则，并建立集中数字档案支持调查。
AI.research_question: 如何通过公民参与和数字技术有效打击公共基础设施项目中的腐败问题？
AI.motivation: 公共基础设施项目中的腐败问题严重影响了资源分配效率和公共服务质量，需要创新的公民监督机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公民参与理论、透明度与问责制理论、数字治理理论
AI.method: 建立公民驱动的监督框架，结合社交媒体举报和集中数字档案系统
AI.findings: PIAC框架能够有效增强公共基础设施项目的透明度和问责制，通过公民参与减少腐败机会

title: The Starbucks Effect: Can Companies Really Go Zero-Waste?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Starbucks Effect: Can Companies Really Go Zero-Waste?
detail.abstract: The drive for zero-waste operations has also become a hallmark of the corporate agenda for sustainability, and Starbucks has been a leading case study in pursuing this goal. The commitment of the company to being an environmental steward is reflected in its diversified initiatives in curtailing waste and encouraging sustainable practices. But the feasibility and effectiveness of attaining an out rightly zero-waste operation in the midst of the complexities of a global business world are still topics of critical analysis.

contentFormat.other: Study on earnings impact by shifting of alternative fuel tanks from above deck to below deck on panamax upwards dry bulk carrier vessels

detail.abstract: With the approaching goal of Carbon Net Zero, shipping companies worldwide are racing toward alternate fuels. However, as of now, the International Maritime Organization (IMO) has not issued specific directives regarding the type of alternate fuel to be adopted. Consequently, research and development efforts are being carried out by various companies experimenting with a range of alternate fuels, including ammonia, liquefied natural gas (LNG), biofuels, methanol, hydrogen, and even nuclear energy. Some companies have installed solar sails on their ships to enhance efficiency. Despite these efforts, there is no consensus, adequate infrastructure, or sufficient availability of alternate fuels to cater to the vast number of vessels currently navigating the global waters. Most design of bulk carriers have alternate fuel tanks fitted on top of the deck behind the accommodation area which can be a safety issue in case of a piracy attack or accident at sea or port as the tanks are not protected. Shifting them below deck would reduce the carrying capacity unless the vessel dimensions are changed. This study reflects loss in earnings by shifting the alternate fuel tanks from above deck to below deck by changing the dimensions same for various panamax upward vessels and recommends that smaller vessels, ultramax and below should opt for bio-fuel so they do not need such change in design.

detail.abstract:
תקציר

מאמר זה מציע קריאה מחודשת ומערכתית לסיפור הבריאה בספר בראשית (פרקים א'-ג'), ומבקש לגשר על הפער ההיסטורי שבין הנרטיב הדתי-מסורתי לבין הממצאים המדעיים והאבולוציוניים. התיזה המרכזית גורסת כי סיפור הבריאה מתחלק לשני נרטיבים מקבילים ומובחנים:

1. פרק א׳ אינו תיאור כרונולוגי-פיזי, אלא משל להתפתחות התודעה האנושית הקולקטיבית (״אלוהים״) - מרגע ההתעוררות מתוך ה"תהו ובהו" ועד ליכולת ההכרה וההבחנה הבסיסית ( אור / חושך, יבשה / ים ).

2. פרק ב׳ מהווה נרטיב מקביל המתאר את הכרונולוגיה הפיזית של יצירת העולם והאדם ("יהוה אלוהים"), וחושף תאימות נשגבת לרצף האבולוציוני: מעולם של אדמה ומים, דרך המחזור ההידרולוגי וצמיחת הצומח, ועד יצירת ה״אדם״ כ ״נפש חיה״ (יונקים/חיים מוקדמים).

על בסיס הפרשנות הכפולה, המאמר מראה כיצד העולם המדעי מפספס את החיבור הקריטי הזה בשל הקריאה השגויה של פרק א' כרצף פיזי. פרקים ב' ו-ג' מתוארים כשיאו של התהליך: תיאור ההתגלמות הפיזית של התודעה (כתנות עור) וכינון האדם כישות מודעת באמצעות השגת ה ״דעת טוב ורע״. בניתוח זה, מוצעת פרספקטיבה תיאולוגית-פסיכולוגית חדשנית, המציבה את הכתובים כמקור לגיטימציה תיאולוגית לתהליכים האבולוציוניים, ובכך מאפשרת לאחוז יחד בנרטיב הרוחני המכונן ובמציאות המדעית-האבולוציונית של קיום האדם.

English Abstract: This article proposes a revised and systematic reading of the Creation Story in the Book of Genesis (Chapters 1–3), seeking to bridge the historical gap between the traditional religious narrative and scientific/evolutionary findings.


The central thesis posits that the Creation Story is divided into two distinct and parallel narratives:


1. Chapter 1 is not a chrono-physical description, but an allegory for the development of collective human consciousness ("Elohim")—from the moment of awakening out of the "Tohu V'Vohu" (chaos) to the fundamental ability to perceive and make basic distinctions (light/dark, land/sea).


2. Chapter 2 serves as a parallel narrative describing the physical chronology of the creation of the world and man ("YHWH Elohim"), revealing a sublime compatibility with the scientific evolutionary sequence: from a world of land and water, through the hydrological cycle and the emergence of flora, and finally to the creation of 'Adam' as a 'living soul' (early life/mammals).


Based on this dual interpretation, the article demonstrates how the scientific world misses this critical connection due to the flawed reading of Chapter 1 as a physical sequence. Chapters 2 and 3 are depicted as the culmination of the process: the description of the physical embodiment of consciousness (the 'garments of skin') and the establishment of man as a conscious entity through the attainment of 'the knowledge of good and evil'.


This analysis offers a novel theological-psychological perspective, positioning the Scriptures as a source of theological legitimation for evolutionary processes, thereby allowing the spiritual narrative and the scientific-evolutionary reality of human existence to be held in harmony.

title: Reconstructing the Law of Supply and Demand: A Unified Dynamic Framework for Micro and Macro Economics and Its Policy Applications

detail.title: Reconstructing the Law of Supply and Demand: A Unified Dynamic Framework for Micro and Macro Economics and Its Policy Applications
detail.abstract: Traditional economic theories, relying on homogeneous agents and static equilibrium assumptions, fail to adequately explain structural unemployment and income polarization under technological shocks. This paper proposes a dynamic framework based on heterogeneous agents to reconstruct the law of supply and demand. It analyzes how technological advancements affect income distribution, labor markets, and overall economic development. By introducing the willingness-to-pay ordering model, the marginal cost staircase model, and the skill threshold model, the paper explores how technological advancements influence workers across different income groups and skill levels. Using empirical data from multiple countries, the paper provides theoretical support for policies aimed at achieving inclusive growth and discusses how education, technology, and international trade policies can be coordinated to address technological shocks.

title: N m'a faamu. Boosting Learning Through Bilingual Education: Evidence from Mali

detail.title: N m'a faamu. Boosting Learning Through Bilingual Education: Evidence from Mali
detail.abstract: Despite increased school enrollment across Sub-Saharan Africa, learning outcomes remain critically low. In this paper, I explore the replacement of colonial languages as the primary medium of instruction in Africa as an educational intervention designed to enhance student learning. This study evaluates the long-term impacts of Mali's 1999 national bilingual education reform, which introduced 11 local languages into the primary school curriculum as languages of instruction. Exploiting spatial variation in policy implementation and using a difference-in-differences approach with commune-level data, the study finds that exposure to bilingual education significantly improves local language literacy by 30% and French literacy by 10%, and increases school attendance by 5 percentage points. These gains are especially pronounced among women and individuals with educated mothers. Contrary to concerns over national cohesion, the policy does not exacerbate ethnic tensions. The findings contribute to the literature on large-scale bilingual education and the political economy of language use in Africa, suggesting that integrating local languages into education systems can enhance human capital without undermining nation-building.

title: Ferreting Out Unregulated "Profit-Neutral" Tunneling: The Case of "Dual-Identity" Subsidiaries in Chinese Business Groups
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance (SAIF) and

detail.title: Ferreting Out Unregulated "Profit-Neutral" Tunneling: The Case of "Dual-Identity" Subsidiaries in Chinese Business Groups

declarations.funderStatement: Cheng would like to thank the National Natural Science Foundation of China (grant No. 72272008) for financial support; Wang would like to thank the National Natural Science Foundation of China (grant No. 72172090) for financial support.

detail.abstract: Related party transactions (RPTs), once a key expropriation channel in Chinese business groups, have sharply declined under strict regulation. However, controlling shareholders circumvent these rules. We provide systematic evidence that these shareholders tunnel resources from listed parent firms to "dual-identity subsidiaries" (DISs), non-wholly owned subsidiaries in which these shareholders also hold minority stakes, through unregulated, undisclosed transactions. In China’s top 300 listed firms, DISs show 66% higher profitability and 64% higher dividend payouts than non-DISs do. Using Bertrand et al. (2002)’s approach, we attribute the superior performance of DISs to tunneling, revealing continued shareholder expropriation beyond regulated RPTs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在中国严格监管关联交易后，控股股东通过"双重身份子公司"（DISs）进行资源隧道输送，这些非全资子公司中控股股东也持有少数股权，通过未受监管、未披露的交易实现利益输送。
AI.research_question: 在关联交易受到严格监管后，控股股东如何继续通过其他渠道进行资源隧道输送？
AI.motivation: 中国关联交易监管趋严，但控股股东仍在寻找规避监管的渠道进行利益输送，需要识别这些新的隧道输送机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于隧道理论（tunneling theory）和关联交易监管框架，探讨监管规避行为。
AI.method: 采用Bertrand et al. (2002)的方法，分析中国前300家上市公司数据，比较DISs与非DISs的盈利能力和分红水平。
AI.findings: DISs的盈利能力比非DISs高66%，分红支付高64%，表明存在显著的资源隧道输送。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了"双重身份子公司"这一新的隧道输送渠道，扩展了隧道理论在监管规避情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了识别新型利益输送渠道的证据，有助于完善监管政策。

title: A Strategic Framework for Responding to National Economic Security Policies (자국 중심의 경제안보 전략 대응을 위한 프레임워크 구축방안 연구)

detail.title: A Strategic Framework for Responding to National Economic Security Policies (자국 중심의 경제안보 전략 대응을 위한 프레임워크 구축방안 연구)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the global race in industrial policy and its intersection with national economic security strategies, examining how the Republic of Korea (ROK) can establish its strategic direction to mitigate risks from policy competition while maximizing its national interests. Driven by isolationist motives, a new trend in industrial policy has emerged, leading to the fragmentation of global value chains and, even worse, toward “deglobalization.” This trend threatens not only the international free trade system but also potentially undermines the ROK’s economic security interests. To address these challenges, we draw upon empirical and model evidence to propose strategic positioning for the ROK through clearly defined industrial policies. (The rest omitted)

AI.tldr: 本文探讨全球产业政策竞争与韩国经济安全战略的交叉点，分析韩国如何在政策竞争中降低风险并最大化国家利益。
AI.research_question: 韩国如何在产业政策竞争中确立战略方向，以减轻政策竞争风险并最大化国家利益？
AI.motivation: 受孤立主义动机驱动的新产业政策趋势导致全球价值链碎片化甚至"去全球化"，这不仅威胁国际自由贸易体系，还可能损害韩国的经济安全利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策理论、经济安全战略、全球价值链理论
AI.method: 基于实证和模型证据的分析方法
AI.findings: 提出了通过明确界定的产业政策为韩国确立战略定位的建议
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对产业政策竞争与经济安全战略交叉领域的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国在产业政策竞争中制定有效战略提供了实践指导

title: GDP Alternatives Revisited: a systematic review of barriers to the adoption of alternative measures of economic progress
affiliations: University of the District of Columbia and University of the District of Columbia

detail.title: GDP Alternatives Revisited: a systematic review of barriers to the adoption of alternative measures of economic progress
detail.abstract: For almost a century, the United States and countries around the world have measured their economic progress through the Gross National Product (GNP) and its close relative, the Gross Domestic Product (GDP). GDP measures the final goods and services produced in a country or region in monetary units. Neither positive nor negative social and environmental impacts of economic activity are included in the measure. There is a considerable body of work arguing that GDP is not a measure of social welfare and distorts the impact of economic activity Given its well-documented shortcomings, a plethora of alternative measures have been developed to correct the welfare distortions of GDP. Collectively they are known as Beyond GDP (BGDP) measures. However, to date, none of the alternatives proposed over the past 50 years have been widely adopted. This study examines the lack of progress toward the adoption of an alternative measure to GDP using a systematic review of the BGDP literature as its starting point for examining barriers to the adoption of BGDP measures. We found that only 2.4% of the considerable literature on BGDP measures includes discussion of adoption barriers. This lack of consideration of practical operational issues stands out. Our review finds five key issues that constitute barriers to adopting a GDP alternative: 1) the inability to shift paradigms 2) the misalignment of data needs and public sector structures 3) the lack of resources, 4) the lack of a cohesive communication strategy, and 5) the lack of user training.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统回顾Beyond GDP文献，分析了GDP替代指标未被广泛采用的原因，发现仅有2.4%的文献讨论采纳障碍，并识别出五个主要障碍：范式转换困难、数据需求与公共部门结构不匹配、资源不足、缺乏统一的传播策略以及用户培训缺失。
AI.research_question: 为什么过去50年提出的GDP替代指标（Beyond GDP措施）未能被广泛采用？
AI.motivation: GDP作为经济进步衡量指标存在明显缺陷，无法反映社会福祉和环境影响的负面效应，虽然已有大量替代指标被提出，但无一被广泛采纳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Beyond GDP文献的系统回顾，分析采纳障碍的理论框架。
AI.method: 对Beyond GDP文献进行系统回顾和分析。
AI.findings: 仅有2.4%的BGDP文献讨论采纳障碍；识别出五个关键采纳障碍：范式转换困难、数据需求与公共部门结构不匹配、资源不足、缺乏统一的传播策略、用户培训缺失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地识别和分类了BGDP指标采纳的主要障碍，为理解政策工具采纳提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供了克服BGDP指标采纳障碍的具体方向，包括改进数据系统、加强传播策略和培训等。

title: Adoption Is Not Enough: A Behavioral Perspective on the Imperfect Substitution of Green Alternatives
affiliations: ESCP Business School and Catholic University of Louvain (UCL)

detail.title: Adoption Is Not Enough: A Behavioral Perspective on the Imperfect Substitution of Green Alternatives
detail.abstract: Companies increasingly pursue economic and environmental goals simultaneously through the development of green products, services, or business models. However, the environmental savings of such green alternatives depend on their substitution effect. This paper explores this often-overlooked contingency by drawing on theories of behavioral change to explain how substitution ratios may be improved. After reviewing several alternative theories of behavioral change, we evaluate their ability to explain carsharing’s substitution for private cars. We find that some individual intentions are associated with increased substitution while others are not, resulting in inconsistent behavior. Moreover, our results point to the importance of changes in context in shaping substitution ratios.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨绿色产品替代效应的行为机制，以汽车共享为例，发现个体意图对替代效果的影响不一致，而情境变化对替代比率有重要影响。
AI.research_question: 绿色替代品（如汽车共享）如何有效替代传统产品（私家车）？行为改变理论如何解释替代比率的变化？
AI.motivation: 企业在追求经济和环境双重目标时开发绿色产品，但绿色替代品的环境效益取决于其替代效果，这一关键因素常被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为改变理论，包括个体意图理论和情境变化理论。
AI.method: 理论回顾和实证评估，以汽车共享替代私家车为案例。
AI.findings: 某些个体意图与替代率增加相关，但其他意图无关，导致行为不一致；情境变化对替代比率有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合行为改变理论解释绿色替代效应，强调情境因素在行为改变中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计更有效的绿色产品提供指导，通过优化情境因素提高替代效果，实现更好的环境效益。

title: On the Heresthetics of Salience: Competing over Voters’ Attention
affiliations: University of Southampton, Athens University of Economics and Business - Department of International and European Economic Studies and

detail.title: On the Heresthetics of Salience: Competing over Voters’ Attention

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates a voting model in which two candidates strategically compete in a winner-take-all election. Voters consider both the spatial dimension of policy positions and other attributes, or valence, of each candidate. Candidates are policy motivated and endeavor to make specific attributes ”salient” in voters’ minds by leveraging their comparative advantages to influence the voting outcome - a form of ”heresthetic” behaviour. The paper offers three contributions. First, it characterizes Salient Political Equilibria and suggests ways in which the notion of salience can be made operational. Second, it provides novel experimental evidence supporting voting salient behaviour. Third, it offers empirical evidence that candidates internalize the externality that ensues from voters salient behaviour, in the context of the European migration crisis of 2015. The theoretical, experimental, and empirical findings challenge the conventional median voter paradigm and its implications by highlighting the significant impact of voters’ salience on electoral outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个投票模型，其中两位候选人战略性地竞争赢家通吃的选举。选民同时考虑政策立场的空间维度和其他属性（或价值）。候选人是政策驱动的，并试图通过利用他们的比较优势来影响投票结果，使特定属性在选民心中变得"显著"——这是一种"修辞操纵"行为。
AI.research_question: 候选人在选举中如何通过使特定属性显著来战略性地影响投票结果？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统的中位选民范式，探索选民显著性行为对选举结果的重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 显著性政治均衡理论、修辞操纵理论、空间投票模型
AI.method: 理论建模、实验证据、实证分析（以2015年欧洲移民危机为背景）
AI.findings: 候选人确实会内化选民显著性行为带来的外部性，显著性行为显著影响选举结果
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了显著性政治均衡的概念，并提供了使显著性概念可操作化的方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实选举中候选人的战略行为提供了新的视角，挑战了传统的中位选民理论

title: Generative AI and Firm Productivity: Field Experiments in Online Retail
affiliations: , Zhejiang University - College of Economics, Alibaba Group, Columbia University - Columbia Business School and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing

detail.title: Generative AI and Firm Productivity: Field Experiments in Online Retail

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We quantify the impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) on firm productivity through a series of large-scale randomized field experiments involving millions of users and products at a leading cross-border online retail platform. Over six months in 2023-2024, GenAI-based enhancements were integrated into seven consumer-facing business workflows. We find that GenAI adoption significantly increases sales, with treatment effects ranging from 0% to 16.3%, depending on GenAI’s marginal contribution relative to existing firm practices. Because inputs and prices were held constant across experimental arms, these gains map directly into total factor productivity improvements. Across the four GenAI applications with positive effects, the implied annual incremental value is approximately $5 per consumer—an economically meaningful impact given the retailer’s scale and the early stage of GenAI adoption. The primary mechanism operates through higher conversion rates, consistent with GenAI reducing frictions in the marketplace and improving consumer experience. We also document substantial heterogeneity: smaller and newer sellers, as well as less experienced consumers, exhibit disproportionately larger gains. Our findings provide novel, large-scale causal evidence on the productivity effects of GenAI in online retail, highlighting both its immediate value and broader potential.

AI.tldr: 通过大规模随机实验发现，生成式AI在跨境电商平台显著提升生产力，销售增长0%-16.3%，年人均价值约5美元，主要通过提高转化率实现，对小商家和新用户效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）对企业生产力的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 量化GenAI在真实商业环境中的生产力效应，为这一新兴技术的商业价值提供因果证据
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产力理论、技术采纳理论、市场摩擦理论
AI.method: 在领先跨境电商平台进行大规模随机现场实验，涉及数百万用户和产品，持续6个月（2023-2024年），在7个面向消费者的业务流程中集成GenAI增强功能
AI.findings: GenAI采用显著提升销售（效果范围0%-16.3%），在投入和价格不变的情况下直接转化为全要素生产率提升；4个有效应用中年人均增量价值约5美元；主要机制是通过提高转化率减少市场摩擦；小商家、新商家和缺乏经验的消费者获益更大
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了GenAI生产力效应的首个大规模因果证据；揭示了GenAI通过减少市场摩擦提升生产力的机制；识别了技术采纳的异质性效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在零售领域采用GenAI提供了实证依据；识别了最可能从GenAI中获益的用户群体；为GenAI的商业价值评估提供了量化指标

title: Shift or Share? Anatomy of Profit Shifting and Distributional Effects on Workers
affiliations: , Paris School of Economics (PSE),  and

detail.title: Shift or Share? Anatomy of Profit Shifting and Distributional Effects on Workers

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using exhaustive microdata on the worldwide activity of multinational firms from Country-by-Country Reports linked to employer-employee data, we study how profit shifting affects workers' earnings. We estimate that large French multinationals shift 19% of their foreign profits annually to low-tax jurisdictions, resulting in €10.3 billion shifted out of France and €3.7 billion in lost tax revenues. Exploiting France's mandatory profit-sharing policy, which mechanically links subsidiary-level reported profits to workers' compensation, we show that profit shifting reduces annual employees' earnings by 2.6%. Low-income workers are disproportionately affected, the bottom 10% losing 3.2% of wages compared to 2.3% for top 10% earners. Changing the profit-sharing formula to account for global, rather than subsidiary-level, profitability would increase wages by 1.9% overall and 4.1% for workers in profit-shifting subsidiaries.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用法国跨国公司的国别报告和雇主-雇员数据，发现大型法国跨国公司每年将19%的海外利润转移至低税率地区，导致法国损失103亿欧元和37亿欧元税收收入。利用法国强制利润分享政策，研究发现利润转移使员工年收入减少2.6%，低收入工人受影响更大。
AI.research_question: 利润转移如何影响工人收入？
AI.motivation: 跨国公司通过利润转移避税，但对其对工人收入的影响缺乏实证研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 利润转移理论、收入分配理论、公司治理理论
AI.method: 使用法国跨国公司国别报告与雇主-雇员数据的微观数据，利用法国强制利润分享政策作为自然实验
AI.findings: 利润转移使员工年收入减少2.6%，低收入工人损失更大（最低10%收入者损失3.2%，最高10%收入者损失2.3%）
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化利润转移对工人收入的影响，揭示利润转移的收入分配效应
AI.practical_contributions: 提出改变利润分享公式（基于全球而非子公司利润）可提高工资1.9%，在利润转移子公司提高4.1%

title: Equilibrium Trade Regimes: Power- vs. Rules-Based
affiliations: , University of Turin and Sao Paulo School of Economics

detail.title: Equilibrium Trade Regimes: Power- vs. Rules-Based

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Members of the World Trade Organization are increasingly disregarding its rules, raising concerns about the future of the multilateral trading system. To analyze the sustainability of the rules-based trade regime, we develop a dynamic framework of stochastic asynchronous games where the leading country determines the trade regime and leadership changes over time. We show that transitioning from a power-based to a rules-based regime requires the presence of a hegemonic power - i.e., a country significantly larger than all others. Non-hegemonic leading countries benefit from a power-based regime, but may nevertheless uphold rules anticipating that they can lose their dominance in the future. We find that the long-term viability of a rules-based equilibrium hinges on the cost of establishing it, which must be neither too small nor too large, on countries' discount factors and on the degree of turnover in world leadership, both of which must be sufficiently large. In a bipolar state, free-riding and market-power forces further undermine the feasibility of rules-based equilibria. We also highlight the trade-offs that a redesign of the WTO rules must face to remain viable. If the leading country becomes shortsighted, the system needs to become more efficient, offer more latitude to the leading country, or even exclude it from the system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机异步博弈框架分析基于规则的贸易体制的可持续性，发现霸权国家的存在是从权力基础向规则基础体制转型的必要条件。规则基础均衡的长期可行性取决于建立成本、国家贴现因子和世界领导权更替程度。在双极状态下，搭便车和市场力量进一步削弱规则基础均衡的可行性。
AI.research_question: 基于规则的多边贸易体制（如WTO）在成员国日益忽视规则的情况下是否可持续？
AI.motivation: WTO成员国越来越多地无视其规则，引发对多边贸易体系未来的担忧
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机异步博弈动态框架，其中领导国决定贸易体制，领导权随时间变化
AI.method: 动态博弈理论模型分析
AI.findings: 1. 从权力基础向规则基础体制转型需要霸权国家存在；2. 非霸权领导国可能维持规则，预期未来可能失去主导地位；3. 规则基础均衡的可行性取决于建立成本、贴现因子和领导权更替程度；4. 双极状态下搭便车和市场力量削弱规则基础均衡
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了分析贸易体制可持续性的动态博弈框架，揭示了霸权国家在体制转型中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为WTO规则重新设计提供了政策启示：当领导国变得短视时，系统需要更高效、给予领导国更多自由度，甚至将其排除在系统之外

title: The Demand for Economic Narratives
affiliations: Ifo Institute, Ifo Institute, ifo Munich, ifo Munich and ifo Institute Munich

detail.title: The Demand for Economic Narratives

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Economic narratives are pervasive in the public discourse and can shape individual behavior. But so far we know very little about whether households actually demand and value narratives as information. We combine a comprehensive expert survey with a large-scale nationally representative household sample in the U.S. to examine the demand for economic narratives in a high-stakes environment of an unprecedentedly high recession probability. We document a substantial willingness to pay for economic narratives of more than 4 USD, which is higher than for numerical forecast information. The dominant motives for acquiring narratives are intrinsic, but a smaller share of participants also lists instrumental motives. Economic narratives improve respondents’ understanding of recession drivers and shape beliefs about the economy and spending, but exert only a minor impact on quantitative expectations. Our findings underscore the potential of narratives as a tool to improve economic understanding and to foster more informed decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过专家调查和全国家庭样本发现，美国家庭愿意为经济叙事支付超过4美元的费用，高于对数值预测信息的支付意愿。经济叙事主要改善对经济衰退驱动因素的理解，但对定量预期影响较小。
AI.research_question: 家庭是否真正需要并重视经济叙事作为信息？
AI.motivation: 经济叙事在公共话语中普遍存在并能影响个体行为，但我们对家庭是否真正需求并重视这些叙事知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济叙事理论、信息需求理论、行为经济学
AI.method: 结合全面的专家调查与美国大规模全国代表性家庭样本，在高风险环境（前所未有的高衰退概率）中检验对经济叙事的需求。
AI.findings: 1. 对经济叙事的支付意愿超过4美元，高于数值预测信息；2. 获取叙事的主要动机是内在动机，少数参与者也有工具性动机；3. 经济叙事改善对衰退驱动因素的理解，影响经济信念和支出，但对定量预期影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统检验家庭对经济叙事的需求和价值评估，丰富了叙事经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 叙事作为改善经济理解和促进更明智决策的工具具有潜力，为政策沟通和金融教育提供启示。

title: Experiencing Carbon Pricing
affiliations: Georgia State University, , University of Miami Herbert Business School, University of Alabama - Department of Economics, Finance and Legal Studies and

detail.title: Experiencing Carbon Pricing

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many socially desirable policies are not implemented because of their ex-ante unpopularity, but this unpopularity may be overcome through experience with the policy. In this paper, we examine how opposition to carbon pricing in the state of Washington turned into support after voters experienced a cap-and-trade policy with revenues earmarked for environmental purposes – "cap-and-invest." Analyzing voting behavior at the census block group level, we observe that support varies by political affiliation as expected, but experience consistently increases support across the board. Using a proprietary survey, we further show that the increase in support among voters in Washington state is specific to the cap-and-invest policy they experienced; support for carbon pricing or climate policies more generally remained unchanged.

AI.tldr: 华盛顿州实施碳排放交易政策后，选民对该政策的反对转为支持，但支持仅限于他们亲身体验的具体政策，对一般碳定价或气候政策的支持度未变。
AI.research_question: 选民对碳定价政策的反对是否会在亲身体验后转变为支持？这种支持是否仅限于具体体验的政策？
AI.motivation: 许多社会期望的政策因事前不受欢迎而无法实施，但这种不受欢迎可能通过政策体验而改变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策体验对公众态度影响的理论框架，重点关注具体政策体验与一般政策态度的区别。
AI.method: 分析人口普查区块组层面的投票行为，并使用专有调查数据。
AI.findings: 支持度因政治立场而异，但体验一致提高了所有群体的支持度；支持增加仅限于选民亲身体验的具体政策（cap-and-invest），对一般碳定价或气候政策的支持度未变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了政策体验影响公众态度的实证证据，区分了具体政策体验与一般政策态度的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过试点实施克服政策事前反对的策略，强调具体政策设计（如收益指定用途）的重要性。

title: What Are the Effects of Macroeconomic Rates of Return of Investment on Wage Share?
affiliations: University of Lisbon, University of Lisbon and

detail.title: What Are the Effects of Macroeconomic Rates of Return of Investment on Wage Share?

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article assesses the potential effects of the macroeconomic rates of return of private and public investment on wage share for 16 OECD countries from 1980 to 2022. Using the macroeconomic rates of return of investments and the wage share at factor cost and at market price, it was possible to conclude that the first has a positive effect on the wage share. Moreover, the total factor productivity negatively affects the wage share when it comes to private investment, while its influence is positive in the case of public investment. The results were also analyzed according to whether countries presented the total factor productivity of capital above or below the average. This analysis highlights the inverse pattern of the human capital index on wage share, both with respect to the type of investment and to the capital productivity observed across countries.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了1980-2022年16个OECD国家私人和公共投资的宏观回报率对工资份额的影响。研究发现投资宏观回报率对工资份额有正向影响，全要素生产率对工资份额的影响在私人投资和公共投资中呈现相反模式。
AI.research_question: 私人和公共投资的宏观回报率如何影响OECD国家的工资份额？
AI.motivation: 理解不同类型投资对收入分配的影响，特别是对工资份额的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济回报率理论、收入分配理论和全要素生产率理论。
AI.method: 使用1980-2022年16个OECD国家的面板数据，分析投资宏观回报率与工资份额的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 投资宏观回报率对工资份额有正向影响；2. 全要素生产率对工资份额的影响在私人投资和公共投资中相反；3. 人力资本指数对工资份额的影响模式与投资类型和资本生产率相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同类型投资对收入分配的差异化影响机制，特别是全要素生产率在私人和公共投资中的相反作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何通过投资政策调节收入分配的理论依据，特别是在选择私人和公共投资组合时的参考。

title: Meritocracy Across Countries
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Suntory and Toyota International Centres for Economics and Related Disciplines (STICERD), London School of Economics, Yale University, Columbia University and Columbia University in the City of New York

detail.title: Meritocracy Across Countries

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the micro sources and macro consequences of worker–job matching across countries with large income differences. Using internationally comparable data on over 120,000 individuals in 30 countries, we document that workers' skills align more closely with their jobs' skill requirements in higher-income countries, indicative of more meritocratic labor market matching. We interpret this fact through an equilibrium matching model with cross-country differences in three fundamentals: (i) endowments of worker skills and job requirements determining match feasibility; (ii) technology determining the returns to matching; and (iii) idiosyncratic frictions capturing how nonproductive traits affect matching. A development-accounting exercise based on the model, estimated separately for each country, shows that variation in matching frictions explains only a small share of cross-country output gaps. However, improved worker–job matching substantially amplifies the gains from adopting frontier endowments and technology.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了不同收入国家间工人与工作岗位匹配的微观来源和宏观影响。研究发现高收入国家的技能匹配更紧密，但匹配摩擦对跨国收入差距的解释力有限，而改善匹配能显著放大前沿技术和禀赋的收益。
AI.research_question: 不同收入国家间工人与工作岗位匹配的微观来源和宏观后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究不同收入水平国家间劳动力市场匹配效率的差异及其对经济发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡匹配模型，考虑三个基本因素：工人技能和工作要求的禀赋、技术回报、以及影响匹配的异质性摩擦。
AI.method: 使用30个国家超过12万人的国际可比数据，构建均衡匹配模型并进行发展核算分析。
AI.findings: 高收入国家的技能匹配更紧密；匹配摩擦仅能解释一小部分跨国产出差距；改善匹配能显著放大前沿技术和禀赋的收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了考虑跨国差异的均衡匹配理论框架，揭示了匹配效率与经济发展的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家改善劳动力市场匹配效率、促进经济发展提供了政策启示，强调匹配改善对技术采纳收益的放大作用。

title: The Impacts of Development on Energy Transition
affiliations: West Virginia University and West Virginia University - Davis College of Agriculture, Forestry, and Consumer Sciences

detail.title: The Impacts of Development on Energy Transition
detail.abstract: We measure the impact of country’s development on its energy transition. Economic development is often linked to the cultural values of a nation. The Parasite-Stress Theory of Values (PSTV) suggests that regional variation in infectious diseases influences a nation’s culture and values. Drawing on rich and thought-provoking literature on the PSTV, we employ a two-stage least squares method to examine the potential relationship between the historical prevalence of infectious diseases and a nation’s cultural influence on development and then predict the level of the energy transition based upon a country’s development. The first stage result shows statistically significant, negative impacts from the prevalence of historic infectious diseases on development. The second stage results reveal that development’s positive impact on energy transition to renewable energy within a country becomes stronger after implementation of the Kyoto Protocol and the Paris Agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两阶段最小二乘法研究发现，历史传染病流行程度对国家发展有显著负面影响，而发展水平对能源转型的正向影响在《京都议定书》和《巴黎协定》实施后更加显著。

AI.theory_contributions: 验证了寄生虫压力价值观理论在发展经济学中的应用，揭示了传染病历史通过文化价值观影响发展的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解不同国家能源转型差异的新视角，强调了国际气候协议在促进能源转型中的重要作用

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了海湾地区与亚洲主要国家之间经济合作模式的演变，从以能源供应链为主的传统合作转向基于经济多元化战略的全面合作。
