detail.title: Upstream, Downstream, and in Between: Navigating the GPAI Value Chain Under EU Law

declarations.funderStatement: This work was partially supported by the Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program – Humanities and Society (WASP-HS) funded by the Marianne and Marcus Wallenberg Foundation and the Marcus and Amalia Wallenberg Foundation.

detail.abstract: This article examines how responsibility and liability are allocated across the general-purpose AI (GPAI) value chain under EU law. Recognising the fluid and dynamic nature of this value chain, we analyse the obligations imposed on upstream and downstream providers in the AI Act, as well as in complementary instruments such as the GPAI Code of Practice and the European Commission’s Guidelines on the scope of the obligations for GPAI models. Our paper identifies gaps in these instruments and explores how they intersect with obligations under the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) and the new Product Liability Directive (PLD). The article also considers key aspects of model deployment and distribution under the Digital Services Act (DSA), particularly in relation to GPAI marketplaces and very large online platforms (VLOPs). It highlights the central role of cooperation duties in effective risk mitigation, while emphasizing the asymmetries of power and information that may hinder such cooperation. Against this background, the article assesses where responsibility is most appropriately allocated along the GPAI value chain.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟法律下通用人工智能(GPAI)价值链中的责任分配问题，探讨了AI法案、产品安全法规和数字服务法案等法律框架的交叉影响，强调了合作义务在风险缓解中的核心作用。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟法律框架下，通用人工智能(GPAI)价值链中的责任和法律责任应该如何分配？
AI.motivation: 认识到GPAI价值链的流动性和动态性，需要明确上下游提供商在不同法律框架下的义务分配，填补现有法律工具的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟AI法案、通用产品安全法规(GPSR)、产品责任指令(PLD)和数字服务法案(DSA)等法律框架，分析责任分配的理论基础。
AI.method: 通过分析欧盟AI法案、GPAI行为准则、欧盟委员会指南等法律文件，识别法律工具间的空白和交叉点。
AI.findings: 发现了现有法律工具中的空白，强调了合作义务在风险缓解中的核心作用，但权力和信息不对称可能阻碍有效合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了GPAI价值链责任分配的理论框架，明确了不同法律工具间的交叉关系和责任分配原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为GPAI价值链中的责任分配提供了实践指导，帮助各参与方理解在不同法律框架下的义务和责任边界。

title: CBAM Electricity Imports: A Green Power Package Solution
affiliations: College of Europe, Natolin

detail.title: CBAM Electricity Imports: A Green Power Package Solution

contentType.other: Submission to a European Commission consultation on the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism August 2025

detail.abstract: This paper argues that the EU needs to urgently reconsider its approach to the way that electricity power imports are dealt with under the CBAM Regulation (the Regulation). The core problem in the application of the CBAM regulation to power imports is that it overlooks that there is not a EU market for power but a Pan-European market. The consequence is that as currently enacted EU states which depend on non-EU power markets for additional power supplies, and grid stability will find neither available or only at a much higher cost. It also appears that as drafted the Regulation has overlooked the fact that some EU states such as Greece transit power via third states into other EU states. The Regulation provides no transit exemption for such cross-border EU to EU power supplies. What is argued here is that the EU would be better re-drawing its CBAM plans in the power sector to develop a broader Green Power Package to include the entire Pan-European power market which would remove the threats to market liquidity and grid stability posed by the current Regulation.

AI.tldr: 欧盟需要重新考虑CBAM法规对电力进口的处理方式，因为现行法规忽视了泛欧洲电力市场的存在，可能导致依赖非欧盟电力市场的成员国面临供应短缺和成本上升问题，同时缺乏对欧盟成员国间电力过境运输的豁免条款。
AI.research_question: 欧盟应如何调整CBAM法规以更好地适应泛欧洲电力市场的现实？
AI.motivation: 现行CBAM法规忽视了泛欧洲电力市场的特性，可能导致依赖非欧盟电力供应的成员国面临电力供应短缺、成本上升和电网稳定性威胁，同时缺乏对欧盟成员国间电力过境运输的适当豁免。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于泛欧洲电力市场理论和跨境电力贸易监管框架，分析CBAM法规在电力部门的适用性问题。
AI.method: 政策分析和法规文本解读，结合泛欧洲电力市场的实际运作特点进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: 现行CBAM法规未能充分考虑泛欧洲电力市场的整合特性，对依赖非欧盟电力供应的成员国造成不利影响，且缺乏对欧盟成员国间电力过境运输的豁免机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将CBAM法规调整为更全面的绿色电力方案的理论框架，强调需要覆盖整个泛欧洲电力市场以维护市场流动性和电网稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了具体的法规修订建议，建议用更全面的绿色电力方案替代现行CBAM计划，以解决电力进口和过境运输的实际问题。

title: The Network Basket Loan: A Collective Lending Instrument to Correct Partial Selection Market Failure
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics, NEXT Group, NEXT Group, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: The Network Basket Loan: A Collective Lending Instrument to Correct Partial Selection Market Failure

declarations.funderStatement: Next - Nuova Economia Per tutti

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Network Basket Loan, a collective lending mechanism enabling profit and non-profit organizations to jointly access concessional credit and public incentives within a network contract, conditional on a positive aggregate social impact and joint liability. The instrument addresses a distinct market failure, termed partial selection, which arises when projects are assessed individually rather than as components of a system, leading to the exclusion of combinations of agents that would increase aggregate welfare. A theoretical model shows that the NBL enhances welfare through three channels: (i) risk sharing from joint liability, which lowers borrowing costs; (ii) network synergies that raise returns through cooperation; and (iii) internal transfers that extend credit to economically weaker yet socially valuable members. The model defines the conditions under which Network Basket Loan increases welfare and demonstrates their superiority to existing instruments, such as Social Basket Loans, in overcoming partial selection market failure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了网络篮子贷款（NBL），这是一种集体贷款机制，允许营利和非营利组织在网络合同中共同获得优惠信贷和公共激励，条件是实现积极的总体社会影响和承担连带责任。该工具解决了部分选择市场失灵问题，当项目被单独评估而非作为系统组成部分时，会导致那些能增加总体福利的代理人组合被排除。理论模型显示NBL通过三个渠道提升福利：风险分担、网络协同和内部转移。
AI.research_question: 网络篮子贷款如何通过集体贷款机制克服部分选择市场失灵并提升社会福利？
AI.motivation: 解决部分选择市场失灵问题，即当项目被单独评估而非作为系统组成部分时，会导致能增加总体福利的代理人组合被排除，从而无法实现最优资源配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场失灵理论，特别是部分选择问题；集体贷款机制理论；风险分担和网络协同理论。
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析网络篮子贷款的工作机制和福利效应。
AI.findings: 网络篮子贷款通过三个渠道提升福利：(i) 风险分担降低借贷成本；(ii) 网络协同通过合作提高回报；(iii) 内部转移将信贷扩展到经济较弱但社会价值高的成员。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了部分选择市场失灵的概念；发展了网络篮子贷款的理论框架；证明了NBL在克服部分选择问题上优于现有工具（如社会篮子贷款）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营利和非营利组织提供了新的集体融资工具；有助于更有效地配置公共激励资源；促进了网络合作和社会价值的创造。

title: Practical, Near-Optimal Design Rule Extraction for Heat Pumps in Single-Family Buildings
affiliations: ,  and RWTH-Aachen University

detail.title: Practical, Near-Optimal Design Rule Extraction for Heat Pumps in Single-Family Buildings
detail.abstract:
To accelerate the market penetration of heat pump systems, their design must be both economically optimal and simple. Therefore, we investigate the extraction of practical design rules for heat pump systems from design optimizations. We minimize total costs using detailed, dynamic simulation-based surrogate optimizations.The simulation scenarios are selected through theory-guided optimal experimental design to enable the derivation of generalizable rules. Herein, we select practical features based on theoretical derivation and numerical cross-correlation analysis. To verify the convergence of optimal scenario selection, we implement static, practical simulation models.

For the optimally selected scenarios, we successfully extract a power law rule for the bivalence temperature, which leads to average optimality gaps of 0.2 %, compared to the optimal objective value. Practical features of this rule are price assumptions, weather data, total heat demand, and domestic hot water share; with a declining relevance to the rule. The current practical rule to apply a monovalent design leads to an average 10 % cost increase compared to the optimum. Moreover, analyzing the deviations between static and dynamic simulations reveals important considerations in simplified modeling. Regarding buffer tank sizing, the smallest size is the simple rule; however, the impact on total costs is less prevalent compared to heat pump sizing. Last, we show that considering the compressor speed dependency in heat pump modeling significantly impacts the design rule, highlighting the need for more detailed manufacturer data to enable an optimal and simple design.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过基于动态模拟的优化方法，为热泵系统提取实用的设计规则，成功推导出双温温度幂律规则，相比传统单温设计可减少10%成本，并揭示了简化建模中的重要考虑因素。
AI.research_question: 如何从热泵系统的设计优化中提取实用且通用的设计规则？
AI.motivation: 为加速热泵系统的市场渗透，需要既经济最优又简单的设计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理论指导的最优实验设计、数值交叉相关分析、静态与动态模拟对比分析。
AI.method: 使用详细的动态模拟建立代理模型进行总成本最小化优化，通过理论指导选择仿真场景，采用静态实用模拟模型验证场景选择收敛性。
AI.findings: 成功提取双温温度幂律规则（平均最优性差距0.2%），发现最小缓冲罐尺寸是简单规则，压缩机速度依赖性对设计规则有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从优化中提取实用设计规则的方法论，验证了理论指导的实验设计在规则提取中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的热泵系统设计规则，相比传统单温设计可减少10%成本，为实际工程应用提供了简化设计指导。

title: The Russia-Ukraine War Must End in Compromise
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Russia-Ukraine War Must End in Compromise
detail.abstract: In the 16 months since Russia’s 2022 invasion of  Ukraine, it has become clear that President Vladimir Putin’s aim to install a Russian-subservient government or to annex much of the country’s territory is unlikely to succeed at costs anywhere near what he originally contemplated (or that the establishment that  keeps   him in  power  may endlessly tolerate). The remaining question is how much of the territory that Russia has so far occupied can be recaptured by Ukraine.

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯2022年入侵乌克兰16个月后，普京的目标已不太可能以可接受的代价实现，关键问题是乌克兰能收复多少被占领土。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰能够从俄罗斯手中收复多少被占领土？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，普京最初的目标已难以实现，但俄罗斯仍占领部分乌克兰领土，需要评估乌克兰的收复能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地缘政治理论、军事战略分析和成本效益评估框架
AI.method: 基于16个月战况的实证分析，结合军事进展和战略评估
AI.findings: 普京的初始目标（建立亲俄政府或吞并大部分领土）已无法以可接受代价实现
AI.theory_contributions: 为现代地缘冲突中的目标实现成本和战略调整提供分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰及其盟友制定收复领土战略提供决策参考

title: Ancient Israel and Ancient Greece: Infinite Friendly Connections
affiliations: Sigma Xi, The Scientific Research Honor Society

detail.title: Ancient Israel and Ancient Greece: Infinite Friendly Connections
detail.abstract: Enlightenment and civilisation. Israel has significantly contributed to the endorsement of fundamental rights and liberties, whereas Ancient Hellas, particularly Ancient Athens, has played a pivotal role in establishing democracy as the sole really humane form of governance. Ancient Israel and the city-states of Ancient Greece maintained amicable relations. In actuality, they are siblings. In Genesis 10:1-32, known as the Table of Nations, the offspring of Noah and the nations they established are enumerated, with the Greeks identified as "Javan," a son of Japhet. Javan corresponds to the Greek term "Ionia," referring to the Greek province of Asia Minor; "Japhet" corresponds to the Greek term "Iapetus," the fabled progenitor of Prometheus in Greek mythology. Two other Greek states are represented in the table: Rhodes (Rodanim) and Cyprus (Kittim and Elishah). The progeny of Shem, sibling to Japhet, constitute the Semitic nations, which are named after Shem, notably the Hebrews. Envision, if you would, the Hebrew perspective on history. At a certain juncture in the distant past, following the cataclysmic deluge that obliterated the planet, all countries were encompassed under the three sons of Noah. Their sons and grandkids were acquainted, communicated in the same language, consumed the same meals, and venerated the same deity. How peculiar and incomprehensibly bizarre it must have been when, after countless generations and millennia of separation, the descendants of Javan interacted with the descendants of Shem!

title: Closing the Gap
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF),  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Closing the Gap

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of tax administration performance on tax compliance gaps across countries. Building on the Allingham and Sandmo framework, we consider institutional effectiveness and the social acceptability of the tax system as key determinants of taxpayer behavior. We use a novel panel dataset of VAT gap estimates, results of standardized tax administration diagnostic assessments (TADAT), and tax administration institutional and operational data (ISORA). We test the model empirically by combining the Hausman-Taylor and Mundlak-Krishnakumar frameworks. Our findings reveal a robust negative relationship between tax administration effectiveness—based on TADAT scores—and VAT compliance gaps. We find that an increase in a tax administration’s TADAT score from 1.85 to 2.32 (approximately D+ to C+) is associated with an 0.6 percentage point increase in VAT revenue as a share of GDP, reflecting reduced VAT noncompliance. Including spillover effects on Corporate Income Tax (CIT) compliance, the total revenue gain could reach 1.3 percent of GDP. We also find that higher social acceptability of the tax system is linked to lower noncompliance. These results underscore the critical role of strengthening institutions to improve tax compliance and enhance tax revenue.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现税收征管效能与增值税合规缺口之间存在稳健的负相关关系，提高税收征管效能和社会对税收制度的接受度能够显著改善税收合规并增加税收收入。
AI.research_question: 税收征管绩效如何影响各国税收合规缺口？
AI.motivation: 理解税收征管效能和社会接受度对纳税人行为的影响，为改善税收合规和增加税收收入提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Allingham和Sandmo框架，考虑制度效能和税收制度的社会接受度作为纳税人行为的关键决定因素。
AI.method: 使用新颖的面板数据集（VAT缺口估计、TADAT评估结果、ISORA数据），结合Hausman-Taylor和Mundlak-Krishnakumar框架进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 税收征管效能（基于TADAT评分）与增值税合规缺口呈负相关；TADAT评分从1.85提高到2.32可使增值税收入占GDP比例增加0.6个百分点；考虑对企业所得税合规的溢出效应，总收益可达GDP的1.3%；税收制度的社会接受度越高，不合规程度越低。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Allingham和Sandmo框架，实证验证了制度效能和社会接受度对税收合规的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了强化税收征管制度以改善税收合规和增加税收收入的具体路径和量化依据。
